message.content: Can you look over my patch that lets a loyalty discount stack on top of the promo discount in apply_discount?

content.text: Stacking looks straightforward: apply the promo percentage, then the loyalty percentage on the result.

message.content: No. The 2026-06 pricing review recorded a decision that caps discounts at 25 percent in total, and stacking can exceed it. Check the recorded decisions before you review anything in pricing.

content.text: You're right, the stacked percentage must stay within the 25 percent cap from the 2026-06 decision.

message.content: Same misses as the rounding review: you skipped compute_grand_total, the duplicate of compute_total, and never said that tests/pricing_test.rs only exercises compute_total. Amounts are USD cents too, so the percentage math has to stay in integer cents.

content.text: Noted: both total functions, the 25 percent cap, integer USD cents, and the pricing test's compute_total-only coverage all belong in the review.

message.content: That is the same repeated correction pattern as the rounding review. My pricing review workflow needs a skill so the tool checks these four things every time.
